[h1]Gameplay Showcase[/h1]: Witness the convergence of spaceship battles, FPS, and tower defense in the Indie sensation AI.Cybercraft. We'll be playing all three modes live on Steam Fest, offering an exclusive look into the thrilling and dynamic world of our game. From intense space skirmishes to strategic tower defense setups, experience the diversity of gameplay that sets AI.Cybercraft apart. Get a sneak peek not only at the game demo but also at the mid-game content. Immerse yourself in the strategic depth, challenge your gaming skills, and elevate your awareness as we journey through the immersive world of AI.Cybercraft.

[h1]Mechanics Unveiled[/h1]: Delve into the inner workings of AI.Cybercraft's gameplay mechanics. Explore the secrets behind the seamless integration of strategy, gaming skills, and awareness. Dynamic enemy behavior, adaptive environments – every element is meticulously crafted to keep you on the edge of your seat. Prepare to be amazed by the depth and complexity of our game's mechanics.

[h1]Stream Prize – Free Game Keys![/h1]

2-Share a screenshot of Wishlisting AI.Cybercraft on Discord.

Don't miss out on the AI.Cybercraft Extravaganza at Steam Fest – where innovation meets excitement. Be part of this unique gaming experience and secure your chance to win a free game key. notes.title: AI Cybercraft - The Defense Mode Set & Ready For A Demo Test Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CdstdFQ1MiM;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]


As the player, you'll experience dual gameplay perspectives: immerse yourself in the adrenaline-fueled First Person Shooter mode while taking control of the powerful Machine Gun Tower, and seamlessly transition to the third-person view to strategically construct defenses around your base.

Prepare to defend against waves of relentless AI robot enemies set on challenging your base's defenses. Each wave presents a new tactical challenge, demanding swift decision-making and precise coordination between FPS combat and strategic construction.

Exciting news! The game's demo will soon be available on Steam, giving you a firsthand taste of the thrilling gameplay. Stay tuned as AI Cybercraft gears up for its full release in 2024, right after the Steam Festival in February. Don't miss out—wishlist the game on Steam today to be among the first to experience this groundbreaking fusion of strategy and action!

Join our vibrant community on Discord to engage with fellow gamers, share strategies, and stay updated on the latest developments. Get ready to embark on an epic gaming adventure with AI Cybercraft!

Like, share, and subscribe to stay tuned for more exclusive updates, gameplay insights, and behind-the-scenes peeks into the world of AI Cybercraft. Get ready to redefine the boundaries of strategy and FPS gaming!

notes.title: AI.Cybercraft Battleship Artwork Design Contest
notes.content:
1. Planning and Preparation:

Theme: Design AI.Cybercraft battleships inspired by animals or insects with innovative mechanisms.

Submission Formats: 2D (top and left views) or 3D designs (3D is an advantage).

Guidelines: Original, theme-focused designs. Include contact details.

Timeline: Submissions: [10-08-2023] - [30-08-2023]. Winners announced: [10-09-2023]

Spread the word on our Steam page, website, and social media.
Use eye-catching banners and posts to create excitement.
Engage with gaming communities and forums for wider reach.


2. Submission Process:

Submit artwork via the community artwork page of AI.Cybercraft on Steam.
Include artwork, titles, descriptions, and contact details.


3. Judging Criteria:

Evaluate based on creativity, originality, adherence to theme, and technical skill.
The judging panel includes developers, artists, and community members.


4. Prizes and Recognition:

Two winners will be credited in AI.Cybercraft's game credits.
Top designs may be integrated into the game as battleships.

5. Announcement and Feedback:

Winners are announced on [10.09.2023] through our channels.
Constructive feedback is provided to encourage growth. Goodluck!


Share feedback for event improvement.
Stay tuned for future contests!
Join the AI.Cybercraft Battleship Artwork Design Contest and bring nature and mechanism to life in futuristic battleships. Create, inspire, and leave your artistic legacy in AI.Cybercraft's universe!
